business: Greenside: white-label member app + club management software for Dutch golf clubs
by_segment: Board member or paid club manager of an 18-hole club (±950 members, turnover around 1.8 million euro)
Club manager or commercial manager of a 27+ hole club or a commercially run course (±1,350 members)
Volunteer board member of a 9-hole club (±550 members, mostly volunteers)
by_behaviour: Still on E-Golf4U, must choose a new system now
Cautious chair, goes through the members' meeting
why_not: E-Golf4U is going away and I have to pick something my board can defend for the next ten years, not a two-person startup that no club runs yet. A free pilot is nice, but running two systems side by side with 950 mostly older members costs us volunteer time and goodwill, and if it fails we have lost months we don't have.

With 1,350 members, most over 60, I can't put my club on a system that two founders have only just started at one other club. Even a free pilot means running two systems side by side for three months, and that's more work for me, not less.

We only just moved off E-Golf4U, our volunteers are exhausted and the members have barely got used to the new system. Even a free pilot means another round of explaining, inviting and supporting, and I can't sell that to the board this year.

We moved off E-Golf4U less than a year ago and the volunteers and members are only just used to the new system; even a free pilot means another round of explaining, and I can't sell the board a second switch now, especially to two founders with no club live yet.

Our system has run for years and the vendor knows our club; I'm not taking a two-person startup with no live club to my board just to get an app in our own colours. The free pilot is generous, but it still costs my volunteers and our office months of double work.

We have run on our current vendor for years and it works well enough. A free pilot is nice, but our volunteer board would have to run two systems side by side and talk 550 members into another app, and members already have GOLF.NL for tee times on their phone.
flip: Golfclub Zwolle live for a full season, with its board telling me on the phone that tee times, invoicing and the older members all went smoothly, plus a second club of our size on board.
